Statistician=20
Location: U.S. Geological Survey Patuxent Wildlife Research Center=20
(PWRC), Laurel, MD
Responsibilities: Johnson Controls has an open position to perform=20
contract work for the USGS at PWRC. Duties include:
=B7 Interact directly with NPS personnel to assist them with analysis=
=20
of monitoring data, act independently to organize and analyze data, and=20
provide written summaries of the analysis of the project. Individual will =

also contribute to analysis and writing of scientific publications.=20

=B7 Conduct statistical analysis of NPS Monitoring data. This=20
requires an understanding of standard statistical methods such as Analysis =

of Variance, Linear Regression, Generalized Linear Models, as well as an=20
ability to implement biological sampling methods such as capture-recapture =

methods, species richness, site occupancy, and distance methods. Knowledge =

of survey sampling techniques is also important.

=B7 Use statistical computing programs such as SAS and Excel to=20
conduct analyses. Ability to use specialized biological sampling programs=20
MARK and DISTANCE.

=B7 Interact and consult with biologically-based fieldworkers, to be =

able to adequately understand their issues and concerns and collaborate on =

analyses.=20

=B7 Participate in discussions about study design for biological=20
surveys, and have an understanding of simulation-based approaches to power =

analysis.
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree (or higher) with practical experience=20
in the biological sciences, statistical theory and methods, and principles =

of research design, univariate, multivariate, parametric, and=20
nonparametric statistical analyses, and computer applications. This=20
position also requires a working level knowledge of computers, operating=20
systems, and commercial and specialized statistical software packages.
Starting Salary: $24.00/hr with full benefits package including=20
competitive compensation, medical, dental, 401(k), and other employee=20
selected benefit options=20
Closing Date: August 1, 2004.=20
Contact: Johnson Controls is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Individuals=20
with the above experience and qualifications are requested to submit a=20
resume and cover letter by 8/01/04 identifying the position/location for=20
which you are applying via letter, fax, or email including your name,=20
postal and email addresses, and phone number for consideration to:
